meta.title: QCS ranking shows all bidders as “Knocked Out” after conversion to auction (RCA 318540007159)
gaps: Ensure the opened event is specifically the auction converted from an RFQ lot with historical savings not copied.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Ensure the opened event is specifically the auction converted from an RFQ lot with historical savings not copied.

steps.note: Open the existing event that best fits a completed auction with bids.
Open Master QCS and assert that the comparison grid with bidder columns and line items rendered.
Verify each displayed bidder has a real vendor column rather than a placeholder.
Verify the first bidder's landed-price cell is populated in the QCS.
Verify the QCS ranking follows the auction amounts.
Assert that no visible QCS row is marked Knocked Out.
